title: Digital geology map of New Zealand, 2012
credit: Ulrich Lange; based on GNS Science geological resource material
altText: Thematic colour map of New Zealand showing thirteen geological rock groups.
caption: Digital geological map of New Zealand prepared by Ulrich Lange using information derived from GNS Science.
context: Illustrates national geological interpretation presented as a contemporary digital map. The image is independently produced using published GNS information, not the official GNS QMAP sheet.
